worldcombat.skill.spite.summary: Send a slow grudge at a target that has just acted. On a hit it tears 4 PP out of the move the target used last and leaves a grudge on it: heavier steps, slower moves.
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.0: Punish a target that just acted
worldcombat.skill.spite.use.1: Tear out the move a foe leans on
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.0: The grudge reaches %1$s blocks and flies at %2$s blocks per tick.
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.1: On a hit it cuts %1$s PP from the target's last used move; only moves used within the last %2$s are held in memory.
worldcombat.skill.spite.description.2: The grudge clings for %1$s, weighing down steps and slowing moves; the bolt turns at most %2$s degrees per tick, so outrunning or rounding cover shakes it off.
worldcombat.skill.spite.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spite.growth.0: From level %1$s the memory window rises to %2$s s and the grudge lasts %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spite.growth.1: From level %1$s the memory window is %2$s s and the range %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spite.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of casting. Larger values chase harder and are shaken off more often on the way.
worldcombat.skill.spite.preference.ai.le: When on, the user may leave its post to send a grudge; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
